title: SouthWest Vegan Food Tour in Las Vegas
requirements: Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
On this Las Vegas Food Tour, you'll sample delicious foods from around the world but in the convenience of the Southwest area. 

We'll start at a cozy vegan Italian spot, and you'll soon see why that is! We'll have a seat, share some mouth watering food!

Then we'll head over to a local Juice Bar and you'll learn about the benefits of juicing and smoothies. 

Lastly, we'll end at a plant based Mexican eatery where the food is yummy and (almost) guilt free .

We're going to focus our time at 3 major food spots in Southwest Las Vegas. You'll sample everything from comfort food to upscale menu items! All the dishes and foods will be plant based and vary from indulgent to healthy.

You'll walk no more than a half of mile in 2.5 hours because FREE transportation will be provided (for 2-4 people) in between restaurants, and parked nearby.

Note: First location is 18 mins SouthWest of MGM
